data.title: Thousands of migrants depart Ceuta as EU tightens borders
data.description: CEUTA, Spain - Almost all of the tens of thousands of migrants who entered Spain’s enclave of Ceuta in North Africa had left by Saturday, officials said, as some EU countries bolstered their border controls over the sudden influx.

data.title: Search resumes for climbers missing in Pakistan avalanche

data.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv kill nine
data.description: KYIV - Russian attacks on Ukraine’s capital killed at least nine people and wounded more than two dozen others, local officials said on Saturday, with strikes damaging homes and causing fires across the city.

data.title: Missing family of three found buried near Russians
data.description: The arrest of two suspects who confessed to killing two Russian siblings in Chon Buri has led to another tragic discovery involving a Thai family of three who had been reported missing two months ago.

data.title: The History of Talad Noi
data.description: If you’ve spent any time exploring Bangkok’s creative scene, chances are you’ve come across Talad Noi. Known today for its winding alleys, vibrant street art, rustic automotive scrap yards, and aesthetic riverside cafés, this riverside neighbourhood is a favourite for travellers and photographers alike. But behind its trendy facade lies a deep history that shaped Bangkok’s early commerce.

data.title: Fifa scraps share-sale plan after fierce backlash
data.description: Fifa’s plan ⁠to ⁠sell a piece of ​its business empire to outside investors has collapsed following an open ​revolt by football officials worldwide and ‌a major rift among top Fifa executives.

data.title: Democrats' balancing act
data.description: The Democrat Party has long occupied a distinctive place in Thai politics. Traditionally seen as a conservative, pro-establishment party that nevertheless embraces parliamentary democracy and liberal economic policies, it has often served as a bridge between the traditional establishment and urban middle-class voters.

data.title: Thailand seeks to lift investment
data.description: Thailand aims to raise total investment to 30% of GDP to escape the middle-income trap and achieve high-income status within the next 12 years, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: Keegan a player with immense pride and passion
data.description: It was sad to learn of the recent death of Kevin Keegan, a charismatic footballer I greatly admired. I was fortunate enough to be amongst the packed crowd at St James' Park to see Keegan in one of his last games as a player in May 1984. Newcastle were seeking promotion from the Second Division and a win over Derby would just about clinch it. It turned out to be a memorable occasion.
